title: new writes an absolute path into the scaffolded files when run from a subdirectory
body:
Found by vc's auditors in the 2026-09-21 doc audit (E7).

`new` rendered `{{DEVBIN}}` in its templates as `DEVBIN_INVOKE`, which is an absolute path when devbin is called from below the project root. The scaffolded handler, its help page and its test stub are tracked files, so the scaffold baked this machine's path into the project.

Fix: `{{DEVBIN}}` renders as `bin/devbin`, the launcher every project has, wherever `new` runs. lib/tmpl/test.bats's comment says so. Test: scaffold.bats, "new run from a subdirectory writes bin/devbin into the files, never an absolute path", driven red at the parent commit.


## Resolution

Fixed at `e525601`, test driven red first at its parent commit. Full suite 1578/1579 at `ae3b200`: the one failing arm was environment-caused (GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 exported in the running shell defeated readonlygit.bats' stale fixture, and its control arm caught it) and is green in a clean environment; that file is hardened at `ad86870`. Reviewed by vc against this issue; vc's mutants on 0099 and 0104 were killed. Ships in 0.1.4.
